    Minimal right almost split maps #

    If g : E → Z is right almost split and φ : E → E satisfies g φ = g, then g restricted to the range of φ is again right almost split (isRightAS_range). Choosing E of least dimension gives a right almost split map that is right minimal: every such φ is bijective (exists_minimal_rightAS).

    IsRightAS (FDMod.ofLin (FDMod.lin g ∘ₗ (FDMod.lin φ).range.subtype))
